propositions: MCP-only agents cannot query whether a plan-review attestation is current without provoking a refusal error; a read-only CLI tool exists but has no corresponding MCP tool.

A new read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` is added to `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, delegating to the library function `rebar.llm.plan_review_status` and returning a `PlanReviewStatusOut` model with fields `{ok, verdict, reason, verified_at_sha, signed_at}`.
The tool is registered only in the read-tool set (via `register_read_tools`) and not in the write-tool set, ensuring it remains available under readonly mode.
A canonical JSON schema `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json` is required to satisfy the MCP output schema coverage guard `test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py`.

The function `register_read_tools` exceeded its McCabe complexity ceiling; tool registration is delegated to a new module-level `_register_plan_review_tools` seam following the existing `register_bridge_tools` pattern.
